method: Seeded sample (setseed 0.42) of golden 'passed' stop events from the 2026-09-22/23 golden window. Each was verified by hand against raw landing evidence produced by src/transitometer/golden/handcheck.py: the last trip-update snapshots that listed the stop, the first snapshot without it, the scheduled arrival, and (bus) the independent vehicle-position next-stop trace. Times are New York local.

checks.evidence: Prediction 12:52:57 held from 12:53:02 to 12:53:23; stop gone at 12:53:54. VP next stop 306559 -> 306560 between 12:52:03 and 12:52:30.
checks.note: Observed time ~27 s after the VP passage window (known small lag, within the 60 s slack); OTP class unaffected.

checks.evidence: Prediction 14:56:16 held 14:55:58-14:56:19; stop gone at 14:57:12. VP passes 301707 between 14:55:51 and 14:56:19.
checks.note: Faithful to the feed: the vehicle carrying this trip id was 66 min behind schedule; possibly a trip-assignment artifact (BR7 material). Also an example of a bus trip later split per vehicle (29-32 % of bus trips have >1 vehicle).

checks.evidence: Last listing 07:32:39 predicting 07:32:06; stop gone at 07:33:01. VP passes 201745 between 07:31:36 and 07:32:06.
checks.note: Observed time equals the end of the VP passage window.

checks.evidence: Prediction 17:05:07 held 17:04:18-17:04:39; stop gone at 17:05:00. VP next stop flips 100164 <-> 100576 before passing between 17:04:10 and 17:04:41.
checks.note: Late either way. The next-stop flip-flop shows why the cross-check must count each event once (fixed).

checks.evidence: Prediction equal to the scheduled time, still listed 110 s after it (17:44:32-17:44:50); stop gone at 17:45:06. 247N is the trip's origin terminal.
checks.note: Feed echoed the timetable instead of tracking the train. 247N is the trip's origin; origin stops are now excluded from arrival KPIs (94 % of subway origin events show exactly 0 s delay) and a 'stale' status (> 90 s in the past while listed) guards other echoes.

checks.evidence: Prediction 20:31:33 held 20:32:08-20:32:29 (56 s stale, under the 90 s threshold); stop gone at 20:32:50. Matched by the route_direction tier.
checks.note: Confirms the route_direction tier maps 7-line ids to the right scheduled trip.

summary: 6 of 7 correct as first computed; 1 revealed the timetable-echo case (origin stop), fixed by excluding origin/terminal stops from KPIs plus the 'stale' status. Independent VP cross-check (per vehicle): 96.0-96.1 % agreement. Golden outputs are byte-identical across two full runs.
